name: r6-d-e2-epi-fix
author: solx-loop
description: Lineage D / E2 (H33). Stamping showed that the r4 tcgen05 kernel's roughly 2x excess on 32,768 and the 14x14 rows was the GEMM1 epilogue (45-49 us per tile), not operand ingest. Its hreg[4][16] array lived in local memory: 128 B stack and 35-36 LDL/STL per instance, with L1 squeezed by 227 KB of smem. Changes: (1) a register-only epilogue (no per-thread arrays, 112-118 regs, 0 stack); (2) h stored through a per-warp smem transpose, so 4 lanes write each 64-B row segment, and g = fp16(gw*gf*h) ma
